description.fr: Société de raffinage du Gabon exploitant la raffinerie de Port-Gentil, placée sous la tutelle du Ministère du Pétrole. L'État gabonais est l'actionnaire majoritaire.
description.en: Gabon's refining company operating the Port-Gentil refinery, supervised by the Ministry of Petroleum. The Gabonese State is the majority shareholder.

source.name: Ministère du Pétrole du Gabon – Agences sous tutelle

notes: Founding year not verified from an official source (fr.wikipedia: created 1964 as Société Équatoriale de Raffinage; task brief cites 1967) — left null. Former site sogara.info expired. Shareholding per fr.wikipedia: State 68.84%, private 31.16%.

name: Bulk Oil Storage and Transportation Company Limited

description.fr: Société d'État constituée en 1993 pour développer les infrastructures de stockage, de pipelines et de transport en vrac des produits pétroliers et gérer les stocks stratégiques de réserve du Ghana. BOST est également désignée Natural Gas Transmission Utility, chargée du développement des infrastructures de gaz naturel sur le territoire.
description.en: State-owned company incorporated in 1993 to develop storage tanks, pipelines and bulk transportation infrastructure for petroleum products and to hold Ghana's strategic reserve stocks. BOST is also designated Natural Gas Transmission Utility, mandated to develop natural gas infrastructure across the country.

source.name: SIGA – Bulk Oil Storage and Transportation Company

notes: Official website (bost.com.gh) did not resolve during this session; URL kept as listed by SIGA. Address: 30 Gulf Street, South Legon, Accra.

name: Energy Commission of Ghana

description.fr: Organisme créé par l'Energy Commission Act 1997 (Act 541) pour réguler et gérer le développement et l'utilisation des ressources énergétiques du Ghana, y compris l'électricité, les énergies renouvelables et le gaz naturel, et assurer la planification énergétique nationale.
description.en: Body established by the Energy Commission Act 1997 (Act 541) to regulate and manage the development and utilisation of Ghana's energy resources, including electricity, renewable energy and natural gas, and to lead national energy planning.

notes: Included as the natural-gas (downstream gas) licensing regulator. Address: Ghana Airways Avenue, Airport Residential Area, Accra.

name: GNPC Exploration and Production Company Limited

description.fr: Filiale d'exploration-production de GNPC créée pour détenir des participations commerciales et opérer directement dans des blocs pétroliers, afin de renforcer les capacités opérationnelles de la compagnie nationale.
description.en: Exploration and production subsidiary of GNPC created to hold commercial interests and act as operator in petroleum blocks, building the national company's operating capability.

source.name: GNPC – official site (Explorco listed as subsidiary)

notes: Listed as a GNPC entity on the official site; founding year (secondary sources: 2013) not stated on official pages, hence null.

name: GOIL PLC (Ghana Oil Company)

description.fr: Société nationale de distribution de produits pétroliers, constituée le 14 juin 1960 sous le nom d'AGIP Ghana Company Limited, entièrement acquise par l'État en 1974 et rebaptisée Ghana Oil Company en 1976. Cotée à la Bourse du Ghana depuis 2007, GOIL exploite le plus grand réseau de stations-service du pays et commercialise carburants, GPL, lubrifiants et bitume.
description.en: National petroleum-products marketing company, incorporated on 14 June 1960 as AGIP Ghana Company Limited, fully acquired by the Government of Ghana in 1974 and renamed Ghana Oil Company in 1976. Listed on the Ghana Stock Exchange since 2007, GOIL operates the country's largest retail fuel network and markets fuels, LPG, lubricants and bitumen.

notes: State-majority listed company. Address: junction of Kojo Thompson and Adjabeng Roads, Accra.

name: Ghana National Gas Company Limited

description.fr: Société gazière intermédiaire de l'État ghanéen, constituée en juillet 2011, propriétaire et exploitante des infrastructures de collecte, de traitement, de transport et de commercialisation du gaz naturel. Son usine de traitement de gaz d'Atuabo (région Ouest) est en production depuis novembre 2014 et alimente notamment les centrales de la Volta River Authority.
description.en: Ghana's state-owned midstream gas company, incorporated in July 2011, which owns and operates infrastructure for gathering, processing, transporting and marketing natural gas. Its Atuabo gas processing plant (Western Region) has been in production since November 2014, supplying notably the Volta River Authority's power plants.

notes: Official site loads only via JavaScript (no extractable content); facts from SIGA. HQ: 225 Osibisa Close, Airport West, Accra.

name: Ghana National Petroleum Corporation

description.fr: Compagnie pétrolière nationale du Ghana, créée en 1983 par la loi PNDC Law 64 et opérationnelle depuis 1985. Partenaire de tous les accords pétroliers du pays et agrégateur national du gaz, elle est chargée de l'exploration, du développement et de la production durables des ressources en hydrocarbures. Son siège est Petroleum House à Tema.
description.en: Ghana's national oil company, established in 1983 by PNDC Law 64 and operational since 1985. Partner in all petroleum agreements in Ghana and national gas aggregator, it is mandated to lead the sustainable exploration, development and production of the country's hydrocarbon resources. Headquartered at Petroleum House, Tema.

notes: Founding law available at https://petrocom.gov.gh/wp-content/uploads/2022/08/ghana_national_petroleum_corporation_law_19831.pdf. Has a Research & Technology division (see R&D dataset).

name: National Petroleum Authority

description.fr: Autorité de régulation du secteur pétrolier aval du Ghana, créée par le NPA Act 2005 (Act 691). Elle régule l'importation, le raffinage, le stockage, la distribution et la commercialisation des produits pétroliers afin de garantir un secteur efficace, rentable et équitable pour les consommateurs.
description.en: Regulator of Ghana's downstream petroleum sector, established by the NPA Act 2005 (Act 691). It regulates the importation, refining, storage, distribution and marketing of petroleum products to ensure an efficient, profitable and fair industry for consumers.

notes: Address: No. 6 George Walker Bush Highway, Dzorwulu, Accra.

name: Petroleum Commission Ghana

description.fr: Régulateur du secteur pétrolier amont du Ghana, créé par le Petroleum Commission Act 2011 (Act 821) à la suite des découvertes commerciales d'hydrocarbures. La Commission régule et gère l'utilisation des ressources pétrolières, coordonne les politiques du secteur amont et supervise le contenu local et le développement des compétences.
description.en: Regulator of Ghana's upstream petroleum sector, established by the Petroleum Commission Act 2011 (Act 821) following commercial hydrocarbon discoveries. The Commission regulates and manages the utilisation of petroleum resources, coordinates upstream policies and oversees local content and skills development.

notes: Head office: Plot No 4A George Bush Highway, Accra; Western Region office at GNPC Energy House, Takoradi.

name: Tema Oil Refinery Limited

description.fr: Unique raffinerie du Ghana, constituée le 12 décembre 1960 sous le nom de Ghanaian Italian Petroleum Company (GHAIP), mise en service en 1963 et entièrement nationalisée en avril 1977 avant d'être renommée Tema Oil Refinery en 1990. Située dans la zone industrielle lourde de Tema, elle est autorisée à traiter le brut et à commercialiser les produits pétroliers.
description.en: Ghana's only refinery, incorporated on 12 December 1960 as the Ghanaian Italian Petroleum Company (GHAIP), commissioned in 1963, fully nationalised in April 1977 and renamed Tema Oil Refinery in 1990. Located in Tema's Heavy Industrial Area, it is authorised to process crude oil and market petroleum products.

source.name: Tema Oil Refinery – official site; SIGA entity profile

notes: 1963 = commissioning year (official site); 1960 = incorporation as GHAIP (SIGA). Capacity not displayed on the official page (placeholders).

name: Akakus Oil Operations (شركة أكاكوس للعمليات النفطية)

description.fr: Akakus Oil Operations, créée en 1995 sous le nom de Repsol Oil Operations, exploite les champs du bassin de Mourzouk (dont El Sharara) au sud-ouest de la Libye pour le compte de la NOC et de ses partenaires, avec une capacité d'environ 200 000 b/j.
description.en: Akakus Oil Operations, established in 1995 as Repsol Oil Operations, operates the Murzuq basin fields (including El Sharara) in south-west Libya on behalf of NOC and its partners, with capacity of about 200,000 b/d.

notes: HQ city (Tripoli) not explicitly stated on fetched page.

name: Arabian Gulf Oil Company (شركة الخليج العربي للنفط)

description.fr: AGOCO est une société d'exploration et de production entièrement détenue par l'État libyen via la NOC, basée à Benghazi. Elle exploite les champs de Sarir, Messla, Nafoora, Beida et Hamada, des raffineries et le terminal de Marsa El Hariga, avec une production d'environ 300 000 b/j.
description.en: AGOCO is a wholly state-owned upstream company under NOC, based in Benghazi. It operates the Sarir, Messla, Nafoora, Beida and Hamada fields, refineries and the Marsa El Hariga terminal, producing around 300,000 b/d.

notes: Founding year 1971 per official site. Type 'NOC' used for NOC-owned upstream operating subsidiaries.

name: Brega Petroleum Marketing Company (شركة البريقة لتسويق النفط)

description.fr: Brega Petroleum Marketing Company est la filiale de la NOC chargée de la commercialisation et de la distribution des produits pétroliers sur le marché libyen (carburants, GPL, lubrifiants).
description.en: Brega Petroleum Marketing Company is NOC's subsidiary responsible for marketing and distributing petroleum products on the Libyan domestic market (fuels, LPG, lubricants).

notes: Official site blocked our requests (Cloudflare). HQ city and founding year not verified.

name: Harouge Oil Operations (الهروج للعمليات النفطية)

description.fr: Harouge Oil Operations est la société d'opérations conjointe NOC–Suncor (ex-Veba Oil Operations) exploitant les champs Amal, Farigh, Ghani/Jofra, Tibesti et Naga, avec terminal à Ras Lanuf.
description.en: Harouge Oil Operations is the NOC–Suncor joint operating company (formerly Veba Oil Operations) running the Amal, Farigh, Ghani/Jofra, Tibesti and Naga fields, with a terminal at Ras Lanuf.

notes: Official site fetched (Arabic; links to NOC and Suncor). HQ and founding year not stated.

name: Jowfe Oil Technology (الجوف للتقنية النفطية)

description.fr: Jowfe Oil Technology, société de services entièrement détenue par la NOC, a été créée par la résolution 577 du 28 juillet 1983. Elle fabrique et commercialise des produits chimiques, équipements et services de forage et de production pour l'industrie pétrolière et gazière.
description.en: Jowfe Oil Technology, a service company wholly owned by NOC, was established by Resolution 577 of 28 July 1983. It manufactures and markets chemicals, equipment and drilling/production services for the oil and gas industry.

notes: Oilfield services company; type 'NOC' used for NOC-owned operating/service subsidiaries. Bases at Tripoli, Nasser (Zelten), Zellah and Intisar fields.

name: Mabruk Oil Operations

description.fr: Mabruk Oil Operations est la société d'opérations développant et produisant les champs Mabruk (onshore) et Al Jurf (offshore) pour le compte de la NOC et de ses partenaires (TotalEnergies et autres).
description.en: Mabruk Oil Operations is the operating company developing and producing the Mabruk (onshore) and Al Jurf (offshore) fields on behalf of NOC and partners (TotalEnergies and others).

notes: Founding year not stated.

name: Mellitah Oil & Gas B.V. (Libyan Branch)

description.fr: Mellitah Oil & Gas est la société d'opérations conjointe NOC–Eni qui exploite le complexe de Mellitah, les champs Wafa, Abu Attifel et Bouri/Sabratha, et alimente le gazoduc Greenstream vers l'Italie.
description.en: Mellitah Oil & Gas is the NOC–Eni joint operating company running the Mellitah complex, the Wafa, Abu Attifel and Bouri/Sabratha fields, and feeding the Greenstream gas pipeline to Italy.

notes: Partners: NOC and Eni. The domain mellitahog.com.ly listed on noc.ly now shows a domain-ownership notice; mellitahog.ly is the live site.

name: National Oil Corporation (المؤسسة الوطنية للنفط)

description.fr: La National Oil Corporation est la compagnie pétrolière nationale de Libye et le pivot du secteur des hydrocarbures du pays. Elle supervise 24 filiales et opérations (exploration-production, raffinage, commercialisation, services, formation et recherche) et plus de 65 000 employés.
description.en: The National Oil Corporation is Libya's national oil company and the centrepiece of the country's hydrocarbons sector. It oversees 24 subsidiaries and operations (upstream, refining, marketing, services, training and research) and over 65,000 employees.

notes: Founding year 1970 (Law No. 24 of 1970) is from secondary sources; noc.ly does not state it on fetched pages. Chairman named on site: Farhat bin Qadara; APPO Libya page names CEO Masoud Suleman Moussa.

name: National Oil Wells Drilling and Workover Company (الشركة الوطنية لحفر وصيانة آبار النفط)

description.fr: Société de forage et de reconditionnement de puits appartenant à la NOC, elle exploite une flotte d'appareils de forage et de workover sur les champs libyens et dispose de son propre centre de formation et de développement.
description.en: An NOC-owned drilling and workover company operating a fleet of drilling and workover rigs across Libyan fields, with its own training and development centre.

notes: Founding year not stated on site.

name: North African Geophysical Exploration Company

description.fr: NAGECO est la société de services géophysiques (acquisition et traitement sismiques) de la NOC.
description.en: NAGECO is NOC's geophysical services company (seismic acquisition and processing).

notes: Site under construction at research time (Tripoli phone number only). Also listed by US Treasury (2011) as NOC-owned.

name: Ras Lanuf Oil and Gas Processing Company (شركة راس لانوف لتصنيع النفط والغاز)

description.fr: Société par actions entièrement détenue par la NOC, créée par la résolution 137 de 1982, Ras Lanuf exploite le complexe de raffinage et de pétrochimie de Ras Lanuf (éthylène, polyéthylène, aromatiques) avec des bureaux à Tripoli, Benghazi et Sebha.
description.en: A joint-stock company wholly owned by NOC, established by Resolution 137 of 1982, Ras Lanuf operates the Ras Lanuf refining and petrochemical complex (ethylene, polyethylene, aromatics) with offices in Tripoli, Benghazi and Sabha.

source.name: Ras Lanuf Oil and Gas – official site

notes: Resolution amended by Resolution 523 of 1986.

name: Sirte Oil Company for Production, Manufacturing of Oil and Gas

description.fr: Sirte Oil Company est une filiale de la NOC opérant des champs de pétrole et de gaz dans le bassin de Syrte et des installations de traitement et de GNL à Marsa El Brega.
description.en: Sirte Oil Company is an NOC subsidiary operating oil and gas fields in the Sirte basin and processing/LNG facilities at Marsa El Brega.

notes: Official site is JavaScript-only; content not readable. Also identified by US Treasury (2011) as NOC-owned. Founding year not verified.

name: Taknia Libya Engineering Company (تقنية ليبيا للأعمال الهندسية)

description.fr: Taknia Libya Engineering, société par actions entièrement détenue par la NOC créée en 2009, a repris les activités de Teknica (UK) Ltd. Elle assure ingénierie, gestion de projets, construction, inspection et O&M pour les projets pétroliers et gaziers.
description.en: Taknia Libya Engineering, a joint-stock company wholly owned by NOC established in 2009, took over the activities of Teknica (UK) Ltd. It provides engineering, project management, construction, inspection and O&M for oil and gas projects.

name: Waha Oil Company

description.fr: Waha Oil Company est la première filiale productrice de la NOC ; elle exploite les concessions Waha dans le bassin de Syrte pour le compte de la NOC et de ses partenaires internationaux, avec exportation via le terminal d'Es Sider.
description.en: Waha Oil Company is NOC's largest producing subsidiary, operating the Waha concessions in the Sirte basin on behalf of NOC and its international partners, exporting via the Es Sider terminal.

notes: Official site protected by Cloudflare challenge; content not readable. Founding year not verified.

name: Zawia (Azzawiya) Oil Refining Company (شركة الزاوية لتكرير النفط)

description.fr: Créée par décision de la NOC, la Zawia Oil Refining Company exploite la raffinerie de Zaouia (deux unités de 60 000 b/j mises en service en 1974 et 1977), des usines de bitume à Zaouia et Benghazi et une unité de mélange de lubrifiants.
description.en: Established by NOC decision, Zawia Oil Refining Company operates the Zawiya refinery (two 60,000 b/d units commissioned in 1974 and 1977), asphalt plants at Zawiya and Benghazi and a lubricant blending plant.

source.name: Zawia Oil Refining Company – official site

notes: 'founded' = year production started (1974) per official site; incorporation date not stated (commercial register no. 1572).

name: Zueitina Oil Company

description.fr: Zueitina Oil Company est une filiale de la NOC opérant des champs onshore et le terminal d'exportation de Zueitina.
description.en: Zueitina Oil Company is an NOC subsidiary operating onshore fields and the Zueitina export terminal.

notes: Official site is JavaScript-only. HQ city and founding year not verified.

name: Ministry of Mines and Energy – Directorate of Petroleum Affairs (Commissioner for Petroleum Affairs)

description.fr: Le Ministry of Mines and Energy, par le Commissioner for Petroleum Affairs, administre le Petroleum (Exploration and Production) Act de 1991 et le Petroleum (Taxation) Act de 1991 : octroi des licences de reconnaissance, d'exploration (4 ans, renouvelable) et de production (25 ans), approbation des programmes de travaux, notification des découvertes et obligations de démantèlement.
description.en: The Ministry of Mines and Energy, through the Commissioner for Petroleum Affairs, administers the Petroleum (Exploration and Production) Act of 1991 and the Petroleum (Taxation) Act of 1991: award of reconnaissance, exploration (4 years, renewable) and production (25 years) licences, approval of work programmes, notification of discoveries and decommissioning obligations.

notes: mme.gov.na did not resolve via public DNS at time of check (URL kept). A separate 'Namibia Petroleum Fund' could not be verified; NamPower (Kudu gas-to-power) and the Electricity Control Board are electricity entities and were excluded.

name: National Petroleum Corporation of Namibia (Pty) Ltd

description.fr: Compagnie pétrolière nationale de la Namibie, détenue à 100 % par l'État, NAMCOR est régie par le Companies Act 28 de 2004 et tient son mandat du Petroleum (Exploration and Production) Act de 1991 : reconnaissance, exploration et production, seule ou en partenariat, sur l'ensemble des blocs namibiens. Elle exploite aussi l'aval (commercialisation, 18 stations, dépôts et National Oil Storage Facility de Walvis Bay) et le Petroleum Data Centre national.
description.en: Namibia's national oil company, wholly owned by the Government, NAMCOR is governed by the Companies Act 28 of 2004 and draws its mandate from the Petroleum (Exploration and Production) Act of 1991: reconnaissance, exploration and production, alone or in partnership, across Namibian blocks. It also runs downstream operations (marketing, 18 retail sites, depots and the National Oil Storage Facility at Walvis Bay) and the national Petroleum Data Centre.

notes: HQ: Petroleum House, 1 Aviation Road, Windhoek. Founding year 1991 corresponds to the Act cited on the site; the company does not state an incorporation date on the fetched pages. Upstream and Downstream (petroleum trading) are presented as business units, not separate legal subsidiaries.

name: Ministère du Pétrole – Direction Générale des Hydrocarbures

description.fr: Le Ministère du Pétrole applique le Code pétrolier du Niger, attribue les titres et contrats de partage de production et assure la tutelle de la SONIDEP et le suivi des projets (Agadem, raffinerie de Zinder, pipeline d'exportation Niger-Bénin).
description.en: The Ministry of Petroleum applies Niger's Petroleum Code, awards licences and production-sharing contracts and oversees SONIDEP and major projects (Agadem, Zinder refinery, Niger-Benin export pipeline).

notes: Ministry URL as listed on itieniger.ne; the host did not resolve at time of check. Ministry naming varies (Ministère du Pétrole / de l'Énergie et du Pétrole).

name: Société Nigérienne de Pétrole SA (ex-Société Nigérienne des Produits Pétroliers)

description.fr: Créée par l'ordonnance n° 77-01 du 20 janvier 1977, la SONIDEP est une société d'État au capital de 10 milliards FCFA entièrement détenu par l'État du Niger. Historiquement chargée de l'achat, du stockage et de la revente des produits pétroliers (dont une partie de la production de la raffinerie de Zinder depuis 2012), elle a vu ses statuts étendus en 2020 à l'amont (exploration, exploitation, transport, raffinage) et a signé en mars 2024 des contrats de partage de production sur les blocs R5, R6, R7 et Bilma.
description.en: Created by Ordinance No. 77-01 of 20 January 1977, SONIDEP is a state company with capital of CFAF 10 billion wholly held by the State of Niger. Historically responsible for purchasing, storing and reselling petroleum products (including part of the Zinder refinery output since 2012), its statutes were extended in 2020 to upstream activities (exploration, production, transport, refining), and in March 2024 it signed production-sharing contracts for blocks R5, R6, R7 and Bilma.

notes: Postal address BP 10692 Niamey. No reachable official website (sonidep.ne does not resolve). Type set to NOC given the 2020 upstream mandate; originally a downstream company.

name: Société de Raffinage de Zinder

description.fr: Coentreprise entre CNPC (60 %) et l'État du Niger (40 %), la SORAZ exploite la raffinerie de Zinder (Olelewa), mise en service en novembre 2011 (environ 20 000 barils/jour), alimentée par le brut d'Agadem. Une partie de sa production est commercialisée par la SONIDEP.
description.en: A joint venture between CNPC (60%) and the State of Niger (40%), SORAZ operates the Zinder refinery (Olelewa), commissioned in November 2011 (about 20,000 barrels per day) and fed by Agadem crude. Part of its output is marketed by SONIDEP.

source.name: ITIE Niger (SONIDEP page mentions Zinder refinery output)

notes: No official SORAZ website found and no ITIE Niger page for SORAZ. Creation year (2008 JV) and shareholding are institutional history not confirmed on a primary source in this session; start-up 2011.

name: Kaduna Refining and Petrochemical Company Limited

description.fr: Société de raffinage et de pétrochimie de NNPC exploitant la raffinerie de Kaduna (mise en service en 1980), seule raffinerie du nord du Nigeria, avec des unités de lubrifiants et de pétrochimie.
description.en: NNPC refining and petrochemical company operating the Kaduna refinery (commissioned 1980), the only refinery in northern Nigeria, with lubricants and petrochemical units.

notes: Not listed by name in the 2022 NNPC business-unit document; 1980 is the refinery commissioning year (company incorporated 1988).

name: NNPC Engineering and Technical Company Limited

description.fr: Filiale d'ingénierie de NNPC Ltd fournissant des services d'ingénierie, d'approvisionnement, de construction, d'installation, de mise en service, d'exploitation et de maintenance pour l'industrie pétrolière et gazière.
description.en: Engineering subsidiary of NNPC Ltd providing engineering, procurement, construction, installation, commissioning, operations and maintenance services to the oil and gas industry.

source.name: NNPC Ltd – List of business units and subsidiaries (Dec 2022)

notes: Founding year (secondary sources: 1989) and Lagos headquarters not verified on official pages.

name: NNPC Exploration and Production Limited (formerly Nigerian Petroleum Development Company, NPDC)

description.fr: Filiale amont de NNPC Ltd chargée de l'exploration, de l'évaluation, du forage, du développement et de la production d'hydrocarbures (brut, condensats et gaz). Elle succède à la Nigerian Petroleum Development Company (NPDC), renommée dans le cadre de la restructuration consécutive au PIA 2021.
description.en: Upstream subsidiary of NNPC Ltd responsible for exploration, appraisal, drilling, development and production of hydrocarbons (crude, condensate and gas). It succeeds the Nigerian Petroleum Development Company (NPDC), renamed as part of the post-PIA 2021 restructuring.

source.name: NNPC Ltd – List of business units and subsidiaries (Dec 2022)

notes: Founding year 1988 refers to NPDC's incorporation; not stated in the NNPC document. Headquarters Benin City (NPDC legacy HQ) not verified on official pages.

name: NNPC Gas Infrastructure Company Limited (formerly Nigerian Gas Company)

description.fr: Filiale gazière de NNPC Ltd chargée de la construction, de l'exploitation et de la maintenance des infrastructures de gaz naturel (gazoducs et stations de compression). Elle succède à la Nigerian Gas Company (NGC) dans la nouvelle organisation issue du PIA 2021.
description.en: Gas subsidiary of NNPC Ltd responsible for the construction, operation and maintenance of natural gas infrastructure (pipelines and compressor stations). It succeeds the Nigerian Gas Company (NGC) under the post-PIA 2021 structure.

source.name: NNPC Ltd – List of business units and subsidiaries (Dec 2022)

notes: 1988 is the founding year of the predecessor Nigerian Gas Company; headquarters Warri (NGC legacy) not verified on official page.

name: NNPC Gas Marketing Limited

description.fr: Filiale de NNPC Ltd dédiée à la commercialisation et à la distribution du gaz naturel aux clients industriels et commerciaux, ainsi qu'au développement du marché domestique du gaz.
description.en: NNPC Ltd subsidiary dedicated to the marketing and distribution of natural gas to industrial and commercial users and to the development of the domestic gas market.

source.name: NNPC Ltd – List of business units and subsidiaries (Dec 2022)

notes: Founding year not stated in official sources consulted (successor of Nigerian Gas Marketing Company).

name: NNPC RefChem Limited

description.fr: Entité de NNPC Ltd regroupant les activités de raffinage et de transformation chimique, créée lors de la réorganisation post-PIA. Elle chapeaute les raffineries nationales de Port Harcourt, Warri et Kaduna.
description.en: NNPC Ltd business unit grouping refining and chemicals processing, created in the post-PIA reorganisation. It oversees the national refineries of Port Harcourt, Warri and Kaduna.

notes: Listed in the December 2022 NNPC business-unit document; exact incorporation date not stated.

name: NNPC Retail Limited

description.fr: Filiale aval de NNPC Ltd exploitant le réseau de stations-service de la compagnie et commercialisant produits raffinés, lubrifiants, GPL et GNC, ainsi que des activités hors carburant.
description.en: Downstream subsidiary of NNPC Ltd operating the company's retail station network and marketing refined products, lubricants, LPG and CNG, together with non-fuel businesses.

source.name: NNPC Ltd – List of business units and subsidiaries (Dec 2022)

notes: Founding year not confirmed on official pages (secondary sources give 2002 incorporation).

name: Nigeria LNG Limited

description.fr: Coentreprise de liquéfaction de gaz naturel constituée en 1989 entre NNPC (49 %), Shell, TotalEnergies et Eni, exploitant depuis 1999 une usine de six trains de GNL sur l'île de Bonny (État de Rivers), avec un septième train en construction. NLNG est le premier exportateur de GNL du Nigeria et un acteur majeur de la valorisation du gaz associé.
description.en: Natural gas liquefaction joint venture incorporated in 1989 between NNPC (49%), Shell, TotalEnergies and Eni, operating a six-train LNG plant on Bonny Island (Rivers State) since 1999, with a seventh train under construction. NLNG is Nigeria's leading LNG exporter and a major outlet for associated gas.

notes: Joint venture, not wholly state-owned: NNPC holds 49%; included as a state-participated gas company. Shareholding percentages other than NNPC's from company reports.

name: Nigerian Content Development and Monitoring Board

description.fr: Organisme créé en 2010 par le Nigerian Oil and Gas Industry Content Development (NOGICD) Act pour promouvoir et contrôler la participation nigériane dans l'industrie pétrolière et gazière. Basé à la Nigerian Content Tower de Yenagoa (État de Bayelsa), il pilote le renforcement des capacités locales, la certification des équipements et un fonds de recherche-développement.
description.en: Statutory body established in 2010 under the Nigerian Oil and Gas Industry Content Development (NOGICD) Act to promote and monitor Nigerian participation in the oil and gas industry. Headquartered at the Nigerian Content Tower in Yenagoa, Bayelsa State, it drives local capacity building, equipment certification and a research and development fund.

notes: Classified as regulator/content board; also sponsors R&D (see R&D dataset).

name: Nigerian Midstream and Downstream Petroleum Regulatory Authority

description.fr: Autorité de régulation des segments intermédiaire et aval du secteur pétrolier nigérian, créée par le Petroleum Industry Act 2021. Elle est issue de la fusion du Department of Petroleum Resources (fonctions aval), de la Petroleum Products Pricing Regulatory Agency (PPPRA) et du Petroleum Equalisation Fund (PEF), et régule le raffinage, le transport, le stockage et la distribution des produits pétroliers et du gaz.
description.en: Regulatory authority for Nigeria's midstream and downstream petroleum operations, created by the Petroleum Industry Act 2021. It merged the downstream functions of the Department of Petroleum Resources, the Petroleum Products Pricing Regulatory Agency (PPPRA) and the Petroleum Equalisation Fund (PEF), and regulates refining, transportation, storage and distribution of petroleum products and gas.

notes: Official site confirms PIA 2021 establishment and DPR/PPPRA/PEF merger; street address not displayed on fetched pages (headquarters is in Abuja).

name: Nigerian National Petroleum Company Limited

description.fr: Compagnie pétrolière nationale du Nigeria, créée le 1er avril 1977 par la fusion de la Nigerian National Oil Corporation (NNOC) et des fonctions réglementaires du ministère fédéral des Mines et de l'Énergie. Conformément au Petroleum Industry Act (PIA) de 2021, elle a été constituée en société à responsabilité limitée le 16 août 2021 et a commencé ses opérations sous cette forme le 1er juillet 2022. NNPC Ltd intervient sur l'ensemble de la chaîne de valeur : exploration-production, gaz, raffinage, distribution, négoce et nouvelles énergies.
description.en: Nigeria's national oil company, established on 1 April 1977 through the merger of the Nigerian National Oil Corporation (NNOC) and the regulatory functions of the Federal Ministry of Mines and Power. Under the Petroleum Industry Act (PIA) 2021 it was incorporated as a limited liability company on 16 August 2021 and commenced operations in that form on 1 July 2022. NNPC Ltd operates across the whole value chain: upstream, gas, refining, retail, trading and new energy.

notes: Official 'Who we are' page confirms 1 April 1977 merger and 16 August 2021 incorporation. Headquarters: NNPC Towers, Herbert Macaulay Way, Central Business District, Abuja (address confirmed on NNPC Academy page). 2022 operational start (1 July 2022) and 19 July 2022 unveiling from PIA transition announcements.

name: Nigerian Pipelines and Storage Company Limited

description.fr: Filiale de NNPC Ltd chargée des pipelines de produits pétroliers et des dépôts de stockage aval du pays, successeur des activités logistiques de l'ancienne Pipelines and Products Marketing Company (PPMC).
description.en: NNPC Ltd subsidiary in charge of the country's downstream petroleum-product pipelines and storage depots, successor to the logistics activities of the former Pipelines and Products Marketing Company (PPMC).

source.name: NNPC Ltd – List of business units and subsidiaries (Dec 2022)

notes: Founding year not stated in official sources consulted.

name: Nigerian Upstream Petroleum Regulatory Commission

description.fr: Régulateur technique et commercial du secteur amont nigérian, créé par le Petroleum Industry Act signé en 2021, en remplacement du Department of Petroleum Resources (DPR). La Commission délivre les licences et permis d'exploration-production, administre les données pétrolières nationales et veille à la création de valeur durable à partir des ressources pétrolières.
description.en: Technical and commercial regulator of Nigeria's upstream petroleum sector, established by the Petroleum Industry Act signed in 2021 as successor to the Department of Petroleum Resources (DPR). The Commission grants exploration and production licences, administers national petroleum data and promotes sustainable value creation from petroleum resources.

notes: Headquarters address from official site: No. 7 Sylvester Ugoh Crescent, Jabi, Abuja.

name: Petroleum Technology Development Fund

description.fr: Fonds fédéral chargé de développer les capacités humaines et institutionnelles du secteur pétrolier et gazier nigérian, notamment par des bourses, le financement d'institutions de formation et le soutien à la recherche et à l'acquisition de technologies. Le PTDF a créé l'université UGSET de Kaduna (ex-Nigerian College of Petroleum Studies) et finance des centres et chaires dans les universités nigérianes.
description.en: Federal fund mandated to build human and institutional capacity for Nigeria's oil and gas industry through scholarships, funding of training institutions and support for research and technology acquisition. PTDF established the UGSET university in Kaduna (formerly the Nigerian College of Petroleum Studies) and funds centres and chairs in Nigerian universities.

notes: Founding year 1973 corresponds to PTDF Decree No. 25 of 1973 (PTDF Act, Cap P15 LFN 2004); the year is not displayed on the official pages fetched. Address: Plot 1058 Memorial Drive, Central Business District, Abuja.

name: Port Harcourt Refining Company Limited

description.fr: Société de raffinage de NNPC exploitant le complexe de Port Harcourt (raffinerie d'origine de 1965 et nouvelle raffinerie de 1989), d'une capacité nominale combinée de 210 000 barils/jour. Le complexe a fait l'objet d'un programme de réhabilitation dans les années 2020.
description.en: NNPC refining company operating the Port Harcourt complex (original 1965 refinery and 1989 new refinery) with a combined nameplate capacity of 210,000 barrels per day. The complex underwent a rehabilitation programme in the 2020s.

notes: The 2022 NNPC business-unit list does not name the refining companies individually (grouped under NNPC RefChem / NDIS); 1965 is the commissioning year of the first Port Harcourt refinery, corporate incorporation of PHRC dates from 1988. Capacity figures from widely reported NNPC data, not verified on the fetched pages.

name: Warri Refining and Petrochemical Company Limited

description.fr: Société de raffinage et de pétrochimie de NNPC exploitant la raffinerie de Warri (mise en service en 1978) et ses unités pétrochimiques (polypropylène, noir de carbone).
description.en: NNPC refining and petrochemical company operating the Warri refinery (commissioned 1978) and its petrochemical units (polypropylene, carbon black).

notes: Not listed by name in the 2022 NNPC business-unit document; 1978 is the refinery commissioning year (company incorporated 1988). Status as a separate legal entity under NNPC RefChem to be verified.

name: Comité d'Orientation Stratégique du Pétrole et du Gaz

description.fr: Créé par le décret n° 2016-1542 du 3 octobre 2016 (modifié, notamment par le décret n° 2024-1482), le COS-PETROGAZ assiste le Président de la République et le Gouvernement dans la définition et la mise en œuvre de la politique pétrolière et gazière, et supervise, évalue et contrôle l'exécution des projets. Sa composition a été élargie en 2020 à l'opposition et à la société civile.
description.en: Created by Decree No. 2016-1542 of 3 October 2016 (amended, notably by Decree No. 2024-1482), COS-PETROGAZ assists the President and Government in defining and implementing oil and gas policy and supervises, evaluates and controls project implementation. Its membership was broadened in 2020 to include the opposition and civil society.

notes: Strategic steering committee attached to the Presidency rather than a licensing regulator. Address: 18 boulevard de la République, Dakar.

name: Ministère de l'Énergie, du Pétrole et des Mines – Direction des Hydrocarbures

description.fr: Le ministère en charge de l'énergie, du pétrole et des mines exerce, via sa Direction des Hydrocarbures, la tutelle et la régulation du secteur : attribution des titres, contrats de recherche et de partage de production, suivi des opérations et du secteur aval, en lien avec PETROSEN et la Direction générale des Impôts et des Domaines.
description.en: The ministry in charge of energy, petroleum and mines, through its Directorate of Hydrocarbons, oversees and regulates the sector: licensing, exploration and production-sharing contracts, monitoring of operations and of the downstream sector, together with PETROSEN and the Directorate General of Taxes and Domains.

notes: Ministry website returns a PHP error at time of check (URL kept). A 'Comité National des Hydrocarbures' could not be verified.

name: PETROSEN Exploration & Production SA

description.fr: Filiale amont de PETROSEN Holding issue de la réorganisation de 2020, PETROSEN E&P gère les participations de l'État dans les contrats de recherche et de partage de production, le suivi des opérations d'exploration et de développement et la promotion du bassin sédimentaire sénégalais.
description.en: Upstream subsidiary of PETROSEN Holding created in the 2020 reorganisation, PETROSEN E&P manages the State's interests in exploration and production-sharing contracts, monitors exploration and development operations and promotes the Senegalese sedimentary basin.

notes: Existence and role known from PETROSEN's group structure; creation year (2020) not verified on a primary source during this session because petrosen.sn was unreachable.

name: PETROSEN Trading & Services SA

description.fr: Filiale aval de PETROSEN Holding issue de la réorganisation de 2020, PETROSEN Trading & Services porte les activités de négoce, de logistique et de services (participations dans SAR, SENSTOCK et RGS, commercialisation du gaz et des produits).
description.en: Downstream subsidiary of PETROSEN Holding created in the 2020 reorganisation, PETROSEN Trading & Services carries trading, logistics and service activities (stakes in SAR, SENSTOCK and RGS, gas and product marketing).

notes: Creation year and portfolio not verified on a primary source in this session (petrosen.sn unreachable).

name: Réseau Gazier du Sénégal SA

description.fr: Société anonyme à participation publique majoritaire créée en 2019 par l'État, avec PETROSEN, SENELEC, FONSIS et APIX comme partenaires, RGS a pour mission de construire, exploiter, maintenir et développer le réseau national de transport de gaz (segments Nord, Vert, Bleu, Orange, Rouge) au service du gas-to-power et du gas-to-industry.
description.en: A majority state-owned company created in 2019 with PETROSEN, SENELEC, FONSIS and APIX as partners, RGS builds, operates, maintains and develops the national gas transport network (Nord, Vert, Bleu, Orange and Rouge segments) serving gas-to-power and gas-to-industry.

notes: The brief cited 2020; the company site states creation in 2019. Siège: Résidence Coralia, Rue NG-60, Ngor-Almadies, Dakar.

name: Société Africaine de Raffinage

description.fr: Créée en 1961, mise en service le 31 octobre 1963 (600 000 t/an initialement) et inaugurée en 1964, la SAR exploite la raffinerie de Mbao (km 18, route de Rufisque) d'une capacité actuelle de 1,5 million de tonnes par an, avec un projet SAR 2 visant 5,5 Mt/an. Partenaire de PETROSEN, elle emploie 309 personnes et détient les certifications ISO qualité, environnement, SST et laboratoire (ISO 17025).
description.en: Created in 1961, commissioned on 31 October 1963 (initially 600,000 t/yr) and inaugurated in 1964, SAR operates the Mbao refinery (km 18, Route de Rufisque) with a current capacity of 1.5 million tonnes per year and a SAR 2 expansion project targeting 5.5 Mt/yr. A partner of PETROSEN, it employs 309 staff and holds ISO quality, environment, OHS and laboratory (ISO 17025) certifications.

notes: Shareholding percentages (PETROSEN majority) not published on the fetched pages.

name: Société de Stockage d'Hydrocarbures (SENSTOCK)

description.fr: Née en 2008 du rapprochement de la Société Nationale des Hydrocarbures (SNH) et de PETROSEN, rejoints en 2010 par la SPP, SENSTOCK exploite à Mbao (km 18, route de Rufisque) des installations de stockage d'hydrocarbures liquides reliées au quai 8 du Port de Dakar : réception, stockage, chargement camions, soutage et déclarations en douane. Certifiée APAVE et JIG (Jet A1), membre de l'ARDA depuis 2018.
description.en: Formed in 2008 from the combination of the Société Nationale des Hydrocarbures (SNH) and PETROSEN, joined in 2010 by SPP, SENSTOCK operates liquid hydrocarbon storage at Mbao (km 18, Route de Rufisque) linked to berth 8 of the Port of Dakar: reception, storage, truck loading, bunkering and customs declarations. APAVE and JIG (Jet A1) certified, ARDA member since 2018.

notes: State/PETROSEN shareholding percentage not published on the site; included as a PETROSEN-linked storage company.

name: Société des Pétroles du Sénégal (PETROSEN Holding)

description.fr: Société nationale des pétroles créée en 1981, PETROSEN porte les participations de l'État dans les blocs pétroliers et gaziers (Sangomar, GTA) et collecte la part de production revenant à l'État. Réorganisée en 2020 en PETROSEN Holding avec deux filiales, PETROSEN Exploration & Production et PETROSEN Trading & Services, elle intervient sur l'ensemble de la chaîne de valeur.
description.en: The national oil company created in 1981, PETROSEN carries the State's interests in oil and gas blocks (Sangomar, GTA) and collects the State's production share. Reorganised in 2020 into PETROSEN Holding with two subsidiaries, PETROSEN Exploration & Production and PETROSEN Trading & Services, it operates across the value chain.

source.name: EITI – Senegal (PETROSEN as state-owned oil company)

notes: Official site petrosen.sn refused connections during this session (URL kept). Founding year 1981 and the 2020 holding restructuring are institutional history not confirmed on a primary page in this session.

name: Central Energy Fund SOC Ltd

description.fr: Société holding énergétique de l'État sud-africain, créée par le Central Energy Fund Act (No 38 de 1977) et classée entreprise publique de l'Annexe 2. CEF a pour mandat de contribuer à la sécurité d'approvisionnement énergétique du pays et de la région par l'exploration, l'acquisition, le développement et les partenariats stratégiques ; ses filiales comprennent PetroSA, iGas, SFF, AEMFC, PASA et SANPC.
description.en: South Africa's state-owned energy holding company, established under the Central Energy Fund Act (No. 38 of 1977) as a Schedule 2 public entity. CEF's mandate is to contribute to the security of energy supply of South Africa and the region through exploration, acquisition, development and strategic partnerships; its subsidiaries include PetroSA, iGas, SFF, AEMFC, PASA and SANPC.

notes: Address: Block C, Upper Grayston Office Park, 152 Ann Crescent, Strathavon, Sandton. Reports to the Department of Mineral Resources and Energy.

name: National Energy Regulator of South Africa

description.fr: Régulateur national de l'énergie créé par le National Energy Regulator Act (No 40 de 2004), chargé de réguler l'électricité (Electricity Regulation Act 2006), le gaz canalisé (Gas Act 2001) et les pipelines pétroliers (Petroleum Pipelines Act 2003). Il délivre les licences, fixe les tarifs et surveille les opérateurs de ces trois industries.
description.en: National energy regulator established by the National Energy Regulator Act (No. 40 of 2004) to regulate electricity (Electricity Regulation Act 2006), piped-gas (Gas Act 2001) and petroleum pipelines (Petroleum Pipelines Act 2003). It licenses operators, sets tariffs and monitors compliance across the three industries.

notes: Address: Kulawula House, 526 Madiba Street, Arcadia, Pretoria. Operational since 2005.

name: Petroleum Agency SA

description.fr: Agence désignée par l'État pour promouvoir et réguler l'exploration et la production pétrolières et gazières en Afrique du Sud, et dépositaire de la base nationale de données d'exploration-production. Filiale de CEF, elle instruit les permis et droits pétroliers dans le cadre du MPRDA et de la nouvelle loi sur le développement des ressources pétrolières amont.
description.en: State-designated agency that promotes and regulates oil and gas exploration and production in South Africa and acts as custodian of the national exploration and production database. A CEF subsidiary, it processes petroleum permits and rights under the MPRDA and the new Upstream Petroleum Resources Development Act.

notes: Establishment year (secondary sources: 1999) not stated on the official pages fetched, hence null. Address: Heron Place, Heron Close, Century City, Cape Town.

name: Petroleum Oil and Gas Corporation of South Africa SOC Ltd

description.fr: Compagnie pétrolière nationale sud-africaine, lancée en 2002 par le président Thabo Mbeki à partir de la fusion de Mossgas et de Soekor (cette dernière fondée en 1965). Filiale à 100 % de CEF, PetroSA exploite la raffinerie gas-to-liquids de Mossel Bay et les champs gaziers offshore F-A et E-M. Depuis 2025, ses activités viables (négoce, actif ghanéen) sont transférées à la nouvelle SANPC, PetroSA subsistant comme entité de gestion des actifs hérités.
description.en: South Africa's national oil company, launched in 2002 by President Thabo Mbeki from the merger of Mossgas and Soekor (the latter founded in 1965). A wholly owned CEF subsidiary, PetroSA operates the Mossel Bay gas-to-liquids refinery and the offshore F-A and E-M gas fields. Since 2025 its viable operations (trading, Ghana asset) are being transferred to the new SANPC, with PetroSA remaining as a legacy-asset entity.

notes: Address: 151 Frans Conradie Drive, Parow, Cape Town. Post-merger status per Parliament of RSA and Engineering News (April–May 2025): legacy assets ring-fenced with c. 620 employees.

name: South African Gas Development Company SOC Ltd

description.fr: Agence publique créée par directive ministérielle du 2 octobre 2000 pour développer le gaz naturel et ses infrastructures en Afrique australe. Filiale de CEF, iGas détient notamment une participation dans le gazoduc ROMPCO Mozambique–Secunda et promeut la diversification énergétique par le gaz dans la région SADC. Elle fait partie des entités fusionnées dans la SANPC en 2025.
description.en: State-owned agency established by Ministerial Directive of 2 October 2000 to develop hydrocarbon gas and gas infrastructure in Southern Africa. A CEF subsidiary, iGas holds a stake in the ROMPCO Mozambique–Secunda pipeline and promotes gas-based energy diversification in the SADC region. It is one of the entities merged into SANPC in 2025.

name: South African National Petroleum Company SOC Ltd

description.fr: Nouvelle compagnie pétrolière nationale sud-africaine, filiale de CEF, issue de la fusion d'iGas, du Strategic Fuel Fund et des activités viables de PetroSA (division négoce et actif ghanéen). Autorisée à opérer en septembre 2024, elle est entrée en activité le 1er mai 2025 avec environ 420 employés et a été lancée officiellement par le ministre Gwede Mantashe le 23 mai 2025. Elle opère provisoirement sous le CEF Act et la loi PFMA dans l'attente de l'adoption du National Petroleum Company Bill.
description.en: South Africa's new national petroleum company, a CEF subsidiary formed from the merger of iGas, the Strategic Fuel Fund and the viable operations of PetroSA (trading division and Ghana asset). Approved to operate in September 2024, it went live on 1 May 2025 with about 420 employees and was officially launched by Minister Gwede Mantashe on 23 May 2025. It operates on an interim basis under the CEF Act and the PFMA pending passage of the National Petroleum Company Bill.

source.name: Parliament of RSA – New State Petroleum Company starts its work; SAnews.gov.za

notes: Status verified: operational since May 2025; the enabling Bill was approved by Cabinet in Oct 2024 but not yet tabled in Parliament at the time of the source. Website sanpc.co.za is only a domain-reservation page. Headquarters not confirmed on official pages (interim management sits at PetroSA Parow and CEF Sandton); coordinates in other datasets use CEF Sandton address.

name: Strategic Fuel Fund Association

description.fr: Association à but non lucratif filiale de CEF chargée de la gestion des stocks stratégiques de pétrole brut de l'Afrique du Sud et de leurs installations de stockage, notamment le parc de réservoirs de Saldanha Bay et le site de Milnerton. Ses activités ont été intégrées à la SANPC en 2025 selon un modèle de location et de cession d'actifs.
description.en: Not-for-profit CEF subsidiary responsible for managing South Africa's strategic crude oil stocks and their storage facilities, notably the Saldanha Bay tank farm and the Milnerton site. Its operations were folded into SANPC in 2025 under a lease-and-assign asset model.

source.name: CEF Group – official site (subsidiaries); Parliament of RSA

notes: Founding year not confirmed on official pages (secondary sources cite 1964); sffsa.co.za did not resolve during this session. Non-profit (section 21) status noted in SA government material on the SANPC merger.

name: Transnet Pipelines (division of Transnet SOC Ltd)

description.fr: Division de l'entreprise publique de logistique Transnet SOC Ltd, chargée du transport par pipeline des produits pétroliers raffinés, du brut et du gaz méthane-riche entre les ports (Durban) et l'intérieur du pays (Gauteng). Elle exploite notamment le New Multi-Product Pipeline Durban–Johannesburg et est régulée par la NERSA.
description.en: Division of the state-owned logistics company Transnet SOC Ltd responsible for pipeline transport of refined petroleum products, crude oil and methane-rich gas between the coast (Durban) and the inland market (Gauteng). It operates the New Multi-Product Pipeline Durban–Johannesburg and is regulated by NERSA.
